actors:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production PNG sprite atlas for an original cozy snowy-mountain pixel-art combat game.
Primary request: Generate ONE portrait 1024x1536 PNG with a genuine transparent alpha background. Exactly THREE equal columns and FOUR equal rows: TWELVE separate sprites, one centered sprite per cell, no labels, no cell frames. Wide completely transparent gutters and outer margins; each complete sprite including weapons, scarf, body and feet lies wholly inside its own cell with plenty of clear space on all sides, never touching any other cell.
Style: TRUE VERY COARSE PIXEL ART. Each character is designed at only 24–32 logical pixels tall and enlarged with nearest-neighbor into visibly large perfectly square solid pixel blocks. Coarse Celeste-era pixel density, but entirely original designs. Three flat color shades per material, hard stepped pixel edges, at most one logical-pixel fine outline. No smooth character illustration, no antialiasing, no gradients, no glows, no cast shadow, no floor. Sprite interiors are fully opaque; only the empty background has alpha zero. Never draw a checkerboard or backdrop.
First TWO rows show the SAME original small mountain adventurer facing RIGHT in every pose. Cozy and brave: cream knit cap, long coral scarf, teal-blue coat, small orange backpack on back, warm tan boots, simple ice axe. Keep identical anatomy, outfit, proportions and fixed body scale in all six poses.
Row 1 left to right: neutral idle with axe down; windup with axe lifted; strike with axe extended toward RIGHT.
Row 2 left to right: guard with axe protecting front; hurt recoiling backward gently; death/rest pose lying on side with scarf and axe nearby, still wholly within its own cell.
Last TWO rows show the SAME original compact magical violet ice guardian facing LEFT in every pose. Periwinkle crystalline hood and compact body, dark indigo feet, little cyan eyes, small icy staff. Magical, non-violent, readable tiny silhouette. Keep identical anatomy, outfit, proportions and fixed body scale in all six poses.
Row 3 left to right: neutral idle with staff down; windup with staff lifted; strike with staff extended toward LEFT.
Row 4 left to right: guard with staff protecting front; hurt recoiling backward gently; death/rest pose lying on side with staff nearby, still wholly within its own cell.
Composition: Use a precise 3x4 atlas layout. Each cell is approximately 341 pixels wide by 384 pixels tall, with generous empty transparent padding. Large square pixels should remain obvious even viewed at normal output size. No extra poses, no extra columns, no extra rows. Original designs only, no copied game assets, no logos, no text.
icons:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production PNG atlas of original tiny game collectibles for a cozy snowy-mountain pixel-art game.
Primary request: Generate ONE landscape 1536x1024 PNG with genuine transparent alpha background. EXACTLY FOUR equal columns and THREE equal rows: TWELVE separate centered icons in the specified reading order. Each icon wholly contained in its cell, with generous fully transparent gutters and outer margins. No labels, no tile frames, no backdrop. Opaque solid icon interiors, alpha zero outside icons; never draw checkerboard.
Style: TRUE VERY COARSE PIXEL ART. Each icon designed at only 16–24 logical pixels and enlarged nearest-neighbor with visibly large perfectly square blocks. Three flat shades per material, strong distinct silhouettes, at most one logical-pixel outline, hard stepped pixel edges. No antialiasing, gradients, smooth painting, 3D rendering, halos, shadows or decorative microdetails. Original artwork only.
Reading order:
Row 1 column 1: compact silver-blue ice-axe blade with short dark handle.
Row 1 column 2: crystalline cyan shield.
Row 1 column 3: pink lightning shard, bold zigzag shape.
Row 1 column 4: gold feather representing focus.
Row 2 column 1: green venom bottle with simple stopper.
Row 2 column 2: violet round bomb with a small coral fuse.
Row 2 column 3: coral heart.
Row 2 column 4: gold coin.
Row 3 column 1: blue potion flask.
Row 3 column 2: pastel cassette-tape relic.
Row 3 column 3: blue ice crown.
Row 3 column 4: white-cyan four-point star.
Composition: exactly 4x3 rectangular atlas grid. Each cell is 384 pixels wide and approximately 341 pixels tall. Center icons consistently with similar perceived scale and lots of transparent padding; every icon and every piece stays inside its cell. No extra icons. No text, logos, copied game assets, floor or shadows.
arena:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: opaque battle arena background panorama for an original cozy snowy-mountain pixel-art game.
Primary request: Generate ONE landscape 1536x1024 opaque PNG pixel-art panorama: an original mountainous night scene in the spirit of Celeste's atmosphere. No characters, no UI, no text, no logos.
Composition: almost-black midnight navy spacious night sky occupies the top 55 percent. Sparse tiny square white-blue snowfall, with much open dark space and contrast behind future sprites. In the lower background: distant deep teal fir silhouettes, violet-blue abandoned stone ruins and mountain silhouettes. Bright periwinkle ice cliffs have thick cyan-white snow caps and just a few small lime grass sprouts. Bottom THIRD is a continuous walkable snowy ridge: a gently raised flat platform on the left for one future combatant, a gently raised flat platform on the right for one future combatant, and a lower snowy path connecting them through the center. Keep the ridge unbroken. Dark trees and mountains are behind the ridge. Tiny warm yellow lanterns at distant far edges only. No oversized foreground props.
Style: TRUE CRISP COARSE PIXEL ART, as if drawn on a native 256x170 pixel canvas and enlarged approximately 6x using nearest-neighbor. Clearly visible large hard-edged square pixel blocks; flat limited color clusters, three shades per material, no fine microdetail. No antialiasing, blurry gradients, soft brushes, realistic shading, smooth painting or 3D rendering.
Palette: midnight navy sky, deep teal trees, periwinkle and violet-blue ice/ruins, cyan-white snow; restrained coral/purple and tiny yellow details. Calm, cold, magical mountain night with cozy distant lanterns. Original environment only, no copied game assets.
